reuse.why: Extends the existing hidden-filter SQL pattern and shares the template condition as a constant, but does not build on the template module's notion of a category with templates (goal_def) or introduce a shared category selection.

duplication.why: setZero gets a fourth copy of the same categories/category_groups query, and copyPreviousMonth applies the template rule through a separate inverted query plus an in-loop Set check.

placement.why: Logic stays in budget/actions.ts where the actions live, but the eligibility rule is spread across each action's SQL rather than one selection function.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions are touched; single-category actions are left alone.

maintainability.why: The rule of which categories month-wide actions skip now lives in five places (four SQL strings and copyPreviousMonth's checks), joined by string interpolation of a SQL fragment.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth re-expresses the template rule as `NOT ${NO_SAVED_TEMPLATES}` in its own query and a Set filter, instead of sharing the selection the other actions use

one_place.where: Template condition is a shared SQL fragment, but the hidden/group-hidden rule and the selection itself are repeated in setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg SQL and in copyPreviousMonth's loop in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts
